items.question: Why do the report page and OCR enrichment both exist?
items.answer: The questionnaire is the base input, while OCR enrichment strengthens it with past checkup data so the explanation can be more complete.

items.question: What data is included in an export request?
items.answer: Phase 1 export scope covers assessment history, OCR enrichment, check-in records, and community-record summaries.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
body: In Phase 1, MintBit collects questionnaire inputs, optional OCR enrichment, check-in history, and community interactions to generate an explainable personalized nutrition journey.
The platform explicitly distinguishes system-generated content, user-entered content, and user-authorized uploads.

userAgreement.title: User Agreement
body: Notifications, feedback, export requests, and deletion requests in the account center all operate against the current signed-in account.
Feedback submissions and deletion requests keep visible status trails for later handling and tracking.

ocrUsage.title: OCR Data Usage
body: OCR enrichment is only used to strengthen your own nutrition explanation and follow-up tracking. It is not published publicly.
Users can review OCR usage notes and authorization state inside the account center.

communityVisibility.title: Community Visibility
body: Public community posts and comments only appear after moderation review.
The account center explains visibility and moderation rules but does not expose controls that bypass moderation.

auditLog.title: Audit and Operation Transparency
body: To preserve user trust and request traceability, the platform keeps user-visible summaries for export requests, deletion requests, feedback records, and some moderation-state changes.
This page is a transparency explanation with visible summaries, not an internal operations console.
